subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support a public plugin tool-result yield control, with `canYield: true` plus sequential execution as its required capability contract?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it adds a public Plugin SDK control protocol and scheduler/catalog semantics that future external plugins will rely on; this cannot be settled solely by tests.

options.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
options.body: Accept `yieldToolResult` as the supported external seam, preserving the explicit capability and sequential scheduling constraints documented by this PR.

options.title: Pause for a different SDK design
options.body: Keep the runner lifecycle internal until maintainers choose a broader plugin interaction or host-control API shape.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept `yieldToolResult` as the supported external seam, preserving the explicit capability and sequential scheduling constraints documented by this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR builds directly on the previously merged sessions-yield lifecycle that provides the target handoff semantics.
